title: Activities
text:
Scientific initiativesActivities
  Workshops, conference sessions and other opportunities for the Bayesian community to exchange ideas and start collaborations.



  
  
    Most recent meeting
    4–5 June 2026 · CUNEF Universidad, Madrid
    II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics
    Seven keynote speakers and five contributed sessions spanning model selection, computation, spatial and temporal modelling, financial econometrics, robust machine learning and applied Bayesian methods.
    Complete event archive →
  



  Selected history
  
    
      2016
      The working group is foundedThe group was constituted at the 36th SEIO Congress in Toledo, with the aim of providing a meeting point and shared reference for Bayesian statisticians in Spain.
    
    
      2023
      Three sessions at the XL SEIO CongressAt the SEIO Congress in Elche, the group organised sessions on variable selection, early-career research and work by national and international researchers, including an invited contribution by Maria Kalli.
    
    
      2024
      
        I International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics
        The first workshop was held on 17–18 June at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid’s Puerta de Toledo campus. It brought together 37 participants for 17 talks.
        
          Speakers and scientific committee
          
            Keynote speakers: Alan Gelfand (Duke University), Simon Wilson (Trinity College Dublin) and Miguel Ángel Gómez Villegas (Universidad Complutense de Madrid / Universidad CEU San Pablo).
            Invited speakers: María Eugenia Castellanos (Universidad Rey Juan Carlos), David Conesa (Universitat de València), Gonzalo García-Donato (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha), Rosario Susi (Universidad Complutense de Madrid) and Pilar Gargallo (Universidad de Zaragoza).
            Scientific committee: Conchi Ausín, Stefano Cabras, Juanmi Díaz-Araque, Pepa Ramírez-Cobo and Mike Wiper.
          
        
        Original 2024 event page ↗
      
    
    
      2026
      II International Workshop on Bayesian StatisticsThe second edition was hosted by CUNEF Universidad in Madrid. Its full programme, book of abstracts, brochure, venue information and committees remain available in the event archive.

title: II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics
text:
Event archive · 4–5 June 2026 · Madrid
    II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics
    Organised by the Bayesian Working Group of SEIO and CUNEF Universidad.
    
      Programme →
      Venue & documents →
    
  



  
  



  About the meeting
  
    Two days of Bayesian research and exchange.
    
      The II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics was held on 4–5 June 2026 at CUNEF Universidad in Madrid, following the first edition in 2024.
      The single-track meeting combined seven keynote talks with contributed sessions, including work by early-career researchers. Registration was free thanks to support from SEIO and CUNEF Universidad.
    
  



  Keynote speakers
  
    Peter MüllerA semi-parametric Bayesian GLM and applications to outcome dependent sampling
    David RossellHigh-dimensional model selection: transfer learning and projected computation
    Stefano CabrasObjective Bayesian Model Uncertainty Quantification under Missing Data
    Sylvia Frühwirth-SchnatterSparse Bayesian Factor Analysis for Gaussian and non-Gaussian Data
    Lola UgarteOn smoothing risk patterns in areal data
    José Miguel Hernández-LobatoAdvances in Scalable Gaussian Processes
    Daniel Hernández-LobatoJoint entropy search for multi-objective Bayesian optimization with constraints and multiple fidelities

title: Bayesian Working Group
text:
Bayesian Working Group · SEIO
    A meeting point for Bayesian statistics in Spain.
    We bring together researchers and practitioners who develop, study and apply Bayesian methods across statistics, operations research and data science.
    
      Meet the group →
      Our activities →
    
  
  
    From prior to posterior
    p(θ | x) ∝ p(x | θ) p(θ)
    prior
    posterior
  



  01 / About the group
  
    Bayesian ideas, shared across a national community.
    
      The Bayesian Working Group is part of the Spanish Society of Statistics, Operations Research and Data Science (SEIO). It was founded at the 36th SEIO Congress in Toledo in 2016 as a point of reference for the Bayesian community in Spain.
      Our role is practical: to make connections between researchers, create opportunities for scientific exchange, support early-career colleagues and give Bayesian work greater visibility.
    
  



  02 / What we do
  
    
      A
      Convene
      We organise workshops and sessions where new Bayesian research can be presented and discussed.
    
    
      B
      Connect
      We link Bayesian researchers across universities, research centres and fields of application.
    
    
      C
      Support
      We create space for early-career researchers and help circulate relevant opportunities and resources.
    
  



  
  
    Latest meeting · Madrid, 2026
    II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics
    The group’s second international workshop brought the Bayesian community together at CUNEF Universidad. The complete event archive—including the programme, abstracts, practical information and committees—is available here.
    Visit the workshop archive →
  



  03 / Take part
  
    Join the conversation.
    
      If you work with Bayesian methods and would like to join the group, propose an activity or update your directory entry, contact the coordinators.
      Write to the coordinators →
